description: Repairs r-dao-1b/coll-append-field-existing-rows: ZReq was never read back, so whether a Required field appended to a table holding rows stores Null, a zero or nothing was not observed. On a writable copy, on Parent (five rows): a Required Long field ZReq (no default), an optional Long ZOpt and a Text field ZTxt (size 10, AllowZeroLength True) are appended one after another; after each the Fields Count and each Field's Name, OrdinalPosition, Required and AllowZeroLength are read; after the third, Refresh and the same reads; then a new snapshot of ID, ZReq, ZOpt, ZTxt reads every row, and a dynaset over Parent reads ZReq, ZOpt and ZTxt of the first row; the Database is closed, reopened read-only, and the snapshot is read again. Asks what the existing rows hold in each new field, in the same session and after a reopen. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
